data_fields.name: complexity_score
data_fields.donor_constant: boolean operators in the condition + 1; 0 when there is no condition

data_fields.name: once
data_fields.donor_constant: flag per line keyed by line ID; true after the item runs

best_idea: Keep the candidate list, drop failing conditions, rotate by view count with a complexity tie-break, make once a per-line flag keyed by a stable line ID, and have the server check every option pick.
decision_why: The candidate filter, the rotation and the once guard fit NPC barks and quest-giver lines; we change the ranking to a per-group designer choice, seed the random pick per player, and add the server option gate that the donor VM lacks.
acceptance: A server test shows a once line is never offered twice to the same player, a pick on a disabled option is refused, and the same seed and history produce the same bark sequence.
